title: Chapter 274 Real And False Swordsmanship
content:
Chapter 274 Real And False Swordsmanship

Sure enough, as the competition platform returned to peace.

A sharp sword was already crossing the neck of the boy holding the knife.

Qin Feng stood behind him and said lightly: "You lost."

Hearing this, the boy holding the knife looked extremely ugly, "You are cheating."

The boy holding the knife had a heavy voice and was very unwilling to accept it.

If it were just about strength, how could he lose so quickly?

Yes, he didn't seem surprised about losing.

But when Qin Feng heard this, he smiled slightly, "The virtual one is real, the real one is empty, the virtual one is real, the virtual one is real, and the virtual one is real, which is the sword of the virtual one."

The sword path of virtual and real.

The boy holding the knife looked dim, although Qin Feng was fancy just now.

But he could clearly feel that Qin Feng was very strong.

Better than yourself.

What he was most unwilling to be was that he just wanted to have a happy battle.

Even if you lose, there is no complaint.

But this way,

The boy holding the knife shook his head slightly, "I lost."

Immediately, the boy holding the knife slowly walked down the competition platform with heavy steps.

Everyone below finally reacted at this moment.

"Win, win?!"

"Damn, I really won!"

"Qin Feng, Qin Feng!!"

Everyone cheered immediately.

I never expected that Qin Feng, the least favored Qin Feng, actually won.

No one knew at this moment, and there were several pairs of eyes staring at the competition in the secret.

"Hahaha, I am worthy of being my disciple!"

Wang Hao stood in the void, looking at the scene below, smiling from ear to ear.

Several academy veterans beside him also had smiles.

"I have heard that Qin Feng has entered the Dream Secret Realm to practice. It has been ten years since then, and his strength has actually leaped so much. It's not bad, it's not bad."

"This young man is also extraordinary. Judging from the broken knife in his hand, it seems to be the successor of that person."

Someone came to the academy to challenge and defeated the academy's genius. How could such a thing be without the attention of the senior management of the academy?

At this time, someone said, "Now, it seems that my academy cannot do without participating in the troubled times."

"This kid will never be the last one."

When several people heard this, they nodded slightly.

I'm afraid that more and more people will challenge the academy in the future and will become stronger and stronger.

At the same time, the few people set their sights on Lu Xue and Ao Qing.

"What do you think about that nine-clawed dragon?"

"Nine-clawed dragon, it's really strange. I thought it was just a legendary creature, but I didn't expect that I could really meet a living person in my lifetime."

"The Nine-Clawed Dragon follows the girl, and that girl is Xiao Yin's disciple, so it's hard for us to do anything."

"Then let it go?"

The few people were silent, obviously they made a default.

At the same time, on the competition stage, watching the boy holding the knife leave lonely, Qin Feng suddenly shouted at the other party.

"stop!"

"Um?"

The boy holding the knife frowned slightly and turned slowly, "I did lose. Could it be that you still want to insult me?"

Hearing this, everyone around him frowned.

From the moment you enter the academy, you have been despising the academy. Who is insulting whom?

Now I lose, I have the nerve to say this.

Qin Feng also chuckled.

"I really didn't realize that you are actually thicker than me."

"However, you should be clear about what the consequences will be if you fail to challenge the academy?"

Hearing this, the boy holding the knife looked low.

At this time, Qin Feng continued, "If you lose, you have to accept a condition proposed by the academy, and it must be completed. Do you understand?"

As soon as these words were spoken, the onlookers in the academy became excited.

I kept losing, but I actually forgot about this.

Fortunately, Qin Feng mentioned it, otherwise they would have forgotten it.

"Hehe, it's so good to have this guy."

On the side below the stage, Lu Xue and the others were also looking at the boy holding a knife in the distance.

"It must be Brother Qin."

"I haven't seen each other for many years, Qin Feng has already practiced the real sword art to this extent."

"Virtual and true swordsmanship?"

Some people looked suspicious, obviously they didn't understand.

Xu Zijing looked at Qin Feng on the stage, slapped the feather fan in his hand, and smiled lightly: "Brother Qin's former swordsmanship is only empty but not real, so everyone underestimates his strength."

"Now, Brother Qin has achieved great success in his swordsmanship, and has both offense and defense. I'm afraid he will soar into the sky in the future."

Hearing this, everyone was shocked.

Unexpectedly, Qin Feng hid so deeply.

Qin Feng's strength is probably at the top of the martial arts list.

However, it is still a bit far from the evil list.

Of course, this is just what they think.

I'm afraid only he knows what kind of strength Qin Feng has.

"what you up to?"

At this time, the young man holding the knife spoke in a deep voice.

He was a little panicked at this moment.

He didn't know what request this lowly cultivator in front of him would say.

The most important thing is that this is Tiandi Academy, and I can’t even run away if I want to.

Although I looked around, I didn’t see any top strong men in the academy present.

But he knew that there must be top-level strong men in the Tiandi Academy staring at him.

well.

He sighed in his heart, and the boy holding the knife instantly returned to calm.

After all, when he came, this ending was expected.

If he is afraid, he will not come back.

At this time, Qin Feng on the competition stage was also thinking.

How can I punish this ignorant boy?

After pondering for a moment, Qin Feng had an idea.

"It's good that way, please show my Tiandi Academy the gate."

When everyone heard this, they immediately looked happy.

This number.

It just happened to destroy the majesty of this kid.

It made him so arrogant at the beginning.

Lu Xue and others in the distance also nodded slightly in agreement.

It's certainly OK.

The boy holding the knife looked ugly.

"Looking at the door, do you want me to see it for the rest of my life?"

"No, no, no, ten years, no, year, year, right?"

Qin Feng thought about it and decided that it would be better for one year.

If it's ten years, it's really a bit bullying.

After hearing this for a year, the boy holding the knife was still hesitant.

After all, a genius like him will definitely be able to achieve great improvement in one year.

And if you have been looking at the gate of Tiandi Academy for a year, I still don’t know if you can practice well.

"What, you don't want to cheat, right? It's just a year, I'm willing to accept the loss."

Hearing this, the boy holding the knife gritted his teeth, and then he made up his mind, "Okay, it's one year!"

In this way, this sword-holding boy became the gate of Tiandi Academy.

A one-year period.

After the sword-holding boy left, everyone also gave Qin Feng a thumbs up.

"Qin Feng, you are this."

"Brother Qin, you are so handsome. Sure enough, there are some rumors that you can't listen to."

"Brother Qin, we really changed our model."

Qin Feng was calm on the surface for these praises, but he was so excited that he couldn't extricate himself.

It's so cool!

After enjoying the praise, Qin Feng walked off the competition platform and came to Lu Xue and others.

"Sister Xue, you have fulfilled your mission."

Looking at Qin Feng with a smile on his face in front of him, Lu Xue also showed a sweet smile.

"It's a good fight."
